negative_snippets:
I would strongly advise against booking this hotel. I suffer from asthma, and the room I was given was damp and smelled strongly of mould. The pillows were also mouldy, and even the slippers provided in the plastic containers were wet and covered in mould.

I immediately requested new pillows, but the air quality in the room was still unbearable, so I had to switch rooms with my friend. Unfortunately, even the second room was not much better, and neither of us could sleep comfortably.

The food was also disappointing, served from a bain-marie and clearly needed reheating. Overall, this was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve had, and I do not believe anyone should have to endure such conditions.
